C. The OSPF adjacency between the OSPF neighbor and the VSF stack switches (SW2 and SW3) will remain up. Packets destined for SW3 that are received on SW2 are discarded.
D. The stack will split with SW1 remaining an active VSF Master and SW3 becoming another active VSF Master. Switch 2 will remain a VSF member switch.
E. Only the OSPF adjacency between SW3 and the OSPF neighbor will fail. All routed traffic will be redirected to SW2 instead.
